claims.statement: generate_index rebuilds the root index.md and manifest.json purely from Markdown files already on disk, grouping documents by full relative parent path and treating root-level files as the Root group, with input_dir retained only as a deprecated compatibility parameter.

reindex can remove nested index.md/manifest.json artifacts from subdirectories, but only when each file passes a content signature check (index.md starting with '# Knowledge Index' and manifest.json being a JSON array whose entries carry path/title/group); user-content index files are preserved, hidden directories are untouched, and the root pair is always regenerated.

The joining-vaults workflow combines per-document subfolders from multiple output directories into one combined directory and then runs reindex to produce a single unified index/manifest, with distinct parent folders per vault recommended to avoid silent filesystem path collisions before reindex runs.
